commit.subject: LU-20219 osd-zfs: fix symvers paths
commit.message:
LU-20219 osd-zfs: fix symvers paths

When building against ZFS and passing a custom ZFS path via configure,
the configure tests may not pick up symvers because the path
isn't being set correctly. Fix this.
